description: Run a checklist (async): the actor drives a real browser through the product and judges each check, and may use the project's attached MCP servers (list_project_mcp_servers). Returns a run_id; poll get_checklist_run (runs take a few minutes). Counts against the workspace's plan and budget. Results reach the actor's knowledge only with retain_memory.

checklist_id.description: Checklist UUID, from list_checklists or create_checklist.

retain_memory.description: Save this run's check results to the actor's knowledge so it can recall them later. Off by default; only set it when the actor should remember this particular run.

name: run_checklist

run_id.description: Checklist run UUID; poll get_checklist_run with it until status is terminal.

title: Run checklist
